source_notes: BASELINE from the one-time manual sweep of https://agent.distributedapps.ai/directory on 2026-07-28 (4,515+ agents, AIVSS-scored), so the first automated run has something real to diff against instead of an empty month. KEY FINDING: the tight niche terms 'deal sourcing', 'M&A' and 'underwriting' (business M&A, not talent acquisition) returned ZERO direct competitors — no agent in the directory does buy-side deal sourcing or underwriting automation for acquirers (PE / ETA / family offices). The six entries below are the CLOSEST ADJACENT tools found, none of them direct competitors: Ava / Lucy / Placy PRO are sell-side real-estate broker-and-agent transaction copilots, Leni and Kolena Real Estate AI are real-estate analytics point tools, and Strabo is a portfolio tracker. Excluded as false positives on the word 'acquisition': 35+ generic lead-generation agents, sales-automation and CRM agents, and talent-acquisition/recruiting tools. PROVENANCE: url, category, description, pricing and aivss_score for all six were read verbatim off the live directory on 2026-07-28 — the same real card markup captured in tests/fixtures/directory_sample.html — so the canonical /directory/<slug> urls here are the real diff keys. This supersedes an earlier caveat that the slugs had been guessed from agent names; the first automated run will not re-list these six as new entrants.
